'''Trey-yen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
Around [[3641 BBY]], Captain Trey-yen led a strike team on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] to place explosives in order to bring down a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] outpost from below. When the [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] interrupted Trey-yen and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Anders (corporal)|Anders]], Trey-yen attempted to detonate the explosives in order to destroy themselves the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but for reasons unknown to him the bomb failed to detonate. The [[Sith Warrior]] proceeded to kill Trey-yen and his entire squad. Left as the last man standing, Trey-yen futilely tried to detonate the bomb to no avail, before the Warrior [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] him to death. After his death, the Warrior discovered that Lord [[Draahg]] had the real detonator, which he then used in an attempt to kill and bury the Warrior, since Darth Baras had foreseen that his former apprentice would soon overthrow him.
{{Endgame}}
